name: Captive Consciousness
source:
You play as a young adult male in his first year of college, a recent orphan after your father and his fiancé were killed in a tragic accident. As the sole inheritor of your father's house and wealth, you invite Hailey, the daughter of your father's fiancé to live with you.

Sometime later, after an unknown woman shows up to your home, you are thrust into a dark and twisted plot. Orchestrated by those who hold extreme wealth, power, and a severe lack of empathy for those around them.

[From [url=https://tinydogstudio.itch.io/captive-consciousness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名大学一年级的年轻成年男性，在你的父亲和他的未婚夫在一场悲惨事故中丧生后，他刚刚成为孤儿。作为你父亲的房子和财富的唯一继承人，你邀请你父亲未婚夫的女儿海莉和你住在一起。

一段时间后，一名陌生女子出现在你家后，你被卷入了一个黑暗而扭曲的情节。这是由那些拥有极端财富、权力并且对周围人严重缺乏同理心的人精心策划的。

[来自[url=https://tinydogstudio.itch.io/captive-consciousness]Itch.io[/url]]
